The '''1931–32 season''' was '''[[Real Madrid CF|Madrid Football Club]]'s''' [[List of Real Madrid CF seasons|30th season]] in existence, and their [[La Liga records and statistics#All-time La Liga table|4th consecutive season]] in the [[La Liga|Primera División]]. The club also played in the [[Campeonato Regional Centro|Campeonato Mancomunado Centro-Aragón]] (Central-Aragon Joint Championship) and the [[Copa del Rey]]. The establishment of the [[Second Spanish Republic]] in April 1931 caused Real Madrid Club de Fútbol to lose the title "Real" and the royal crown from their crest and badge, and Real Madrid went back to being named Madrid Football Club.

Madrid FC secured their first Primera División title, finishing the league [[List of unbeaten football club seasons|unbeaten]].
